description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rangama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420358
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent, owners, and property details) in various villages in Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
